selected_result: Theorem 3.6: probabilistic componentwise backward error for Doolittle LU factorization

bibliographic_source.title: A New Approach to Probabilistic Rounding Error Analysis

task_clarification: For A in R^(n x n), suppose floating-point Gaussian elimination in Doolittle form runs to completion and outputs LHat and UHat under the source Model 2.1.
For every lambda>0, with probability at least Q(lambda,n^3/3+n^2/2+n/6), there exists DeltaA satisfying A+DeltaA=LHat*UHat and |DeltaA|<=gammaTilde_n(lambda)*|LHat|*|UHat| componentwise.
The computation and the output factors must be linked; the source does not merely assert that some factors exist.
scope_constraints: Preserve run-to-completion, Doolittle operations, exact dimensions, Model 2.1, and the full probability coefficient.
Do not assume the target matrix perturbation or backward identity as a run field.
Keep the componentwise matrix product |LHat|*|UHat| rather than replacing it by a norm bound.
